infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Prompt Aid uses your location to find nearby clinics and, for drivers, to share your live position with patients during an active ride.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Prompt Aid uses your camera for video consultations with your doctor and to photograph documents you choose to send.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Prompt Aid uses your microphone so you can talk to your doctor during video and audio consultations, and to record trip audio for safety when you choose to.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Prompt Aid lets you choose photos to send to your doctor in chat.
